commentary.text: 90+5' Benoit Millot is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Herve Koffi (Angers) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90' Maxime Colin (Metz) is penalised for a foul. Benoit Millot had a clear view and blows his whistle.
89' Metz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
87' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) takes the corner but it's cleared.
87' Louis Mouton (Angers) connects with an accurate pass inside the box and fires the ball to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players steps in to block the effort.
86' Benoit Tavenot has decided to substitute Koffi Kouao and he is replaced by Nathan Mbala (Metz).
85' A snap shot by Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Jonathan Fischer produces a good save to thwart him.
83' Georgiy Tsitaishvili picks out Jessy Deminguet (Metz) unmarked inside the box, but he blazes the ball well over the bar.
81' A substitution has been made. Amine Sbai is replaced by Lilian Raolisoa (Angers).
80' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
80' What was Louis Mouton (Angers) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
79' Metz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
79' Alpha Toure (Metz) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
78' Benoit Millot blows his whistle and it's Harouna Djibirin (Angers) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
77' The game is interrupted now, Louis Mouton (Angers) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
76' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Marius Courcoul (Angers) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marius Courcoul (Angers) is coming onto the pitch as Branco van den Boomen cannot continue after picking up an injury.
69' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to make a change. Goduine Koyalipou (Angers) replaces Prosper Peter.
68' Substitution. Boubacar Traore walks off the pitch and Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) comes on as a substitute.
67' Terry Yegbe (Metz) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
66' Branco van den Boomen (Angers) sends a cross into the box, but Jonathan Fischer comes off his line to gather the ball.

61' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Benoit Millot blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
59' Fode Ballo-Toure goes off the pitch and Maxime Colin (Metz) comes on.
59' It's time for a substitution. Alpha Toure (Metz) comes on in place of Gauthier Hein.
58' The game has come to an end for Believe Munongo. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jessy Deminguet (Metz).
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Haris Belkebla (Angers) departs the field of play to be replaced by Harouna Djibirin.
57' Louis Mouton (Angers) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
57' Substitution. Jacques Ekomie (Angers) leaves the pitch and is replaced by Florent Hanin.

55' Jordan Lefort (Angers) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
55' Branco van den Boomen (Angers) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
49' Amine Sbai (Angers) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
48' Prosper Peter (Angers) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
47' Carlens Arcus (Angers) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Branco van den Boomen (Angers) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
45+5' Branco van den Boomen (Angers) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
43' Louis Mouton (Angers) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
42' Fouls committed – 4:7.
42' Terry Yegbe (Metz) was too forceful with his tackle and Benoit Millot interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
40' Unlucky! A great strike from Branco van den Boomen (Angers) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
39' Amine Sbai (Angers) brings his opponent down. Benoit Millot has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Fode Ballo-Toure (Metz) tackles a bit over-zealously and Benoit Millot blows for a foul.
35' Ousmane Camara (Angers) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
35' Habib Diallo (Metz) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
34' Amine Sbai (Angers) picks out Branco van den Boomen with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
31' Branco van den Boomen (Angers) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Millot and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
27' Fode Ballo-Toure (Metz) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
25' 1 - 0 Louis Mouton (Angers) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
25' Amine Sbai (Angers) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
24' The linesman signals that Habib Diallo (Metz) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
24' Prosper Peter (Angers) commits a foul and Benoit Millot immediately signals a free kick.
23' Louis Mouton (Angers) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
19' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top of the net, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Jonathan Fischer.
17' Branco van den Boomen (Angers) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
16' Benjamin Stambouli (Metz) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
12' Benoit Millot interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Gauthier Hein (Metz).
9' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz). He’s got to go!
9' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz)! Let's see what he decides.
9' Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
4' Habib Diallo (Metz) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Metz will have the kick-off.
Benoit Millot will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
